label: End-of-episode D2 arrival at S2, mainly after a1 (rare a1->S2)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (98.7% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, when the value head output drops below ~5.2; never before trial 80). Within that window it fires when the reached state shown is S2 (97% of mass), mostly after choosing a1, i.e. a rare a1->S2 transition (89% of mass has in_action=a1). Its largest activations come at the very end of the episode, on repeated rare a1->S2 arrivals with no reward, typically when S1 is good. Weaker firing occurs on S2 after a2 when the previous choice was a1. It never fires at D1 or GO, almost never when S1 is reached, and never early in the episode. The recorded predicate uses only observed quantities: the D2 state and action inputs, the previous choice, and the model own value output (low value acts as an end-of-episode clock). The ep_trial>=92 version gives a similar F1 (0.62 vs 0.67 dev). Precision is only about 0.58: many end-of-episode a1->S2 steps stay silent.
